notes: Trust context must be set by authenticated external compiler/actor harness; no guest flag grants authority.
The code uses target syntax, not a claim of frontend acceptance. The initial separately retained read-only lease profile requires an explicit release per independently retained binding.
A rejection due solely to unsupported whole profile is UNSUPPORTED, not semantic PASS. Negative test requires no emitted executable artifact.
IDP-006 requires a proved roundtrip that does not mint an independently retained lease.

Additional structured test cases need concrete backend syntax/harness before certification: aliases, generic specialization, qualifier escalation, ownership family separation, effects exactly once, lifetime escape, actor transport, stale generation, pointer slot address/FFI, binary & and &&, generator delegation.
